verdict.rationale: Termius is a terminal and SSH client with AI features, so AI commit message suggestions are a fair capability to ask about. However, nothing in the evidence shows it reads staged git changes or suggests commit messages. Its documented AI feature turns plain-language descriptions into shell commands, which is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated commit message suggestions based on my staged changes
